test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is always true?

a) The bisectors of angles of a parallelogram form a rectangle.

b) A parallelogram is a trapezium.

c) Diagonals of a rhombus are equal and bisect each other at right angles.
solution:
**Concept used:**

A parallelogram is a quadrilateral with both opposite sides parallel.

A trapezium is a quadrilateral with only one pair of parallel sides.

The diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at right angles.

**Solution:**

a) The bisectors of angles of a parallelogram form a rectangle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffa325bc4317b1291af72a0514383c88c25f74159605f6a5c1e799d378675072.png] 

LMNO is a parallelogram and all bisectors of the angles L, M, N, and O intersect at P, Q, R, and S to form the quadrilateral PQRS. Hence, the angle bisectors of a parallelogram form a rectangle as all the angles are right angles; we conclude that it is a RECTANGLE.

b) A parallelogram is a trapezium.

This is true, because a trapezium has 1 opposite side parallel, while a parallelogram has both opposite sides parallel.

c) Diagonals of a rhombus are equal and bisect each other at right angles.

This is False because the diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at right angles but the diagonals are not equal.

**Hence, the correct option is 3.**
